senses.en: a title used when addressing royalty (Your/His/Her Highness)
senses.zh: 殿下（对王室成员的尊称）

example.en: Your Highness, the carriage is ready.
example.zh: 殿下，马车已经准备好了。

senses.en: the state or quality of being high

example.en: the highness of the mountain peaks
example.zh: 山峰的高峻

senses.en: to coat an object with a thin layer of metal using electricity

example.en: The factory electroplates cheap metal with silver.
example.zh: 这家工厂用电镀的方法给廉价金属镀银。

senses.en: an object coated with metal by electrolysis

example.en: The spoons are fine electroplate, not solid silver.
example.zh: 这些勺子是精致的电镀品，不是纯银的。

senses.en: relating to a hobby or activity done for pleasure, not as a job

example.en: Painting is just an avocational interest for him.
example.zh: 绘画只是他的一项业余爱好。

senses.en: cautious and wary about doing something

example.en: He was chary of lending money to strangers.
example.zh: 他对借钱给陌生人很谨慎。

senses.en: a country in the Middle East at the eastern end of the Mediterranean Sea

example.en: Israel is known for its ancient history and modern technology industry.
example.zh: 以色列以其古老历史和现代科技产业闻名。

senses.en: an ancient kingdom of the Hebrew tribes in the same region
senses.zh: 以色列古国（古代希伯来部落王国）

example.en: The ancient kingdom of Israel was founded around 1025 BC.
example.zh: 以色列古国约于公元前1025年建立。

senses.en: A thin thread-like part of a material, often used to make cloth, rope, or other products.

example.en: The rope is made from strong natural fibers.
example.zh: 这根绳子由结实的天然纤维制成。

senses.en: Plant material in food that the body cannot fully digest but that helps digestion.

example.en: Beans are a good source of dietary fiber.
example.zh: 豆类富含膳食纤维。

senses.en: a first or preliminary version of a document or plan

example.en: She wrote a first draft of the report.
example.zh: 她写了报告的第一稿。

senses.en: a current of cool air coming into a room or vehicle

example.en: A cold draft came through the open window.
example.zh: 一股冷风从开着的窗户吹进来。

senses.en: to write a preliminary version of a document or plan

example.en: They drafted a plan for the project.
example.zh: 他们为这个项目起草了一份计划。

senses.en: The power or force believed to control events in advance.

example.en: He believed that fate had brought them together.
example.zh: 他相信是命运让他们走到了一起。

senses.en: The particular outcome that is destined for someone or something.

example.en: The committee will decide the fate of the old building.
example.zh: 委员会将决定这座老建筑的命运。

senses.en: To be destined or decided in advance, especially in the passive phrase "be fated to".

example.en: They were fated to meet again.
example.zh: 他们注定会再次相见。

senses.en: a main administrative area of a country

example.en: She grew up in a small town in the northern province.
example.zh: 她在北部省份的一个小镇长大。

senses.en: a particular area of activity or knowledge

example.en: Cooking is not my province.
example.zh: 烹饪不是我的专长领域。

senses.en: to control an activity or process by rules or laws

example.en: The agency regulates food safety.
example.zh: 该机构监管食品安全。

senses.en: to adjust the amount, rate, or level of something

example.en: The device regulates the water temperature.
example.zh: 这个装置调节水温。

senses.en: a situation in which there is not enough of something needed

example.en: The city is facing a serious shortage of clean water.
example.zh: 这座城市正面临严重的洁净水短缺。

senses.en: Attractive in a delicate or graceful way.

example.en: She wore a pretty blue dress to the party.
example.zh: 她穿了一条漂亮的蓝色连衣裙去参加聚会。

senses.en: To a moderate degree; fairly.

example.en: The test was pretty easy.
example.zh: 这次考试相当容易。

senses.en: the act of becoming involved in a situation in order to help or change it

example.en: The teacher's intervention stopped the argument before it became serious.
example.zh: 老师的介入在争吵变得严重之前制止了它。

senses.en: the act of trying to settle a disagreement between people or groups

example.en: Both sides accepted the intervention of a neutral mediator.
example.zh: 双方都接受了中立调解人的调停。

senses.en: involvement by one country in the affairs of another

example.en: The report criticized foreign intervention in the region's politics.
example.zh: 该报告批评了外国对该地区政治的干涉。

senses.en: the act of adding something to something else

example.en: The addition of a new chapter improved the report.
example.zh: 新增的一章使报告更加完善。

senses.en: a thing added to something else

example.en: The museum announced a new addition to its collection.
example.zh: 博物馆宣布其藏品新增一件。

senses.en: the mathematical operation of combining numbers to find their total
senses.zh: 加法；把数合并求总和的运算

example.en: Children learn addition and subtraction in early math classes.
example.zh: 孩子们在早期数学课上学习加法和减法。

senses.en: the act of watching or noticing something carefully

example.en: Her quiet observation of the birds lasted an hour.
example.zh: 她安静地观察那些鸟，持续了一个小时。

senses.en: a comment or remark based on something noticed

example.en: He made a brief observation about the weather.
example.zh: 他对天气作了简短的评论。

senses.en: a recorded measurement or piece of scientific data

example.en: The team compared observations from two telescopes.
example.zh: 团队比较了两台望远镜的观测数据。

senses.en: a joint that holds two parts together so one can swing

example.en: The door needs a new hinge.
example.zh: 这扇门需要一个新铰链。

senses.en: to depend entirely on something

example.en: The deal hinges on final approval.
example.zh: 这笔交易取决于最终批准。

senses.en: to attach with a hinge

example.en: They hinged the lid to the box.
example.zh: 他们给箱盖装上了铰链。

senses.en: a twisting force that causes rotation

example.en: The engine produces a lot of torque at low speeds.
example.zh: 这台发动机在低转速时能产生很大的扭矩。

senses.en: a twisted metal collar or necklace worn in ancient times

example.en: The museum displays a golden torque from the Iron Age.
example.zh: 博物馆展出了一件铁器时代的金质项圈。

senses.en: not wild; trained to live with or near people

example.en: The horse is so tame that children can feed it.
example.zh: 这匹马非常驯服，孩子们可以喂它。

senses.en: to make an animal or thing calm, gentle, or under control

example.en: It took months to tame the wild pony.
example.zh: 驯服那匹野马花了几个月。

senses.en: dull and not exciting

example.en: The critics said the film's ending was rather tame.
example.zh: 评论家说这部电影的结局相当平淡。

senses.en: to an endless or unlimited degree; extremely

example.en: The universe seems infinitely large.
example.zh: 宇宙似乎无限广阔。

senses.en: worn out or in poor condition

example.en: He wore a shabby old coat to work.
example.zh: 他穿着一件破旧的外套去上班。

senses.en: unfair or mean in behavior

example.en: It was shabby of him to break his promise.
example.zh: 他违背诺言，这很不光彩。

senses.en: the yellow part in the middle of an egg

example.en: She separated the yolk from the egg white.
example.zh: 她把蛋黄和蛋白分开了。

senses.en: the nutrient-rich material in an egg that feeds a developing embryo

example.en: The embryo absorbs nutrients from the yolk.
example.zh: 胚胎从卵黄中吸收养分。

senses.en: a state of loud noise, confusion, or public protest
senses.zh: 喧闹；骚动；（公众的）强烈抗议

example.en: The new policy caused an uproar among local residents.
example.zh: 新政策在当地居民中引起了强烈抗议。

senses.en: the state or point at which something can hold or absorb no more

example.en: The market has reached saturation, so sales are falling.
example.zh: 市场已经饱和，所以销量在下降。

senses.en: the strength or purity of a color

example.en: Increase the saturation to make the photo more vivid.
example.zh: 调高饱和度让照片更鲜艳。

senses.en: the process of thoroughly soaking something with a liquid

example.en: The saturation of the soil after days of rain caused flooding.
example.zh: 连日降雨使土壤浸透，引发了洪水。

senses.en: to imagine or expect something in the future

example.en: They envisage a complete redesign of the website next year.
example.zh: 他们设想明年对网站进行全面改版。

senses.en: to picture something in the mind

example.en: I envisage a quiet life in the countryside after I retire.
example.zh: 我设想退休后在乡村过安静的生活。

senses.en: the opposite or reverse of something

example.en: Doing nothing is the inverse of taking action.
example.zh: 什么都不做与采取行动正好相反。

senses.en: opposite in order, nature or effect

example.en: The two values show an inverse relationship.
example.zh: 这两个数值呈反比关系。

senses.en: the long tube in the body through which food passes; the intestine or belly

example.en: He felt a sharp pain in his gut after the meal.
example.zh: 饭后他感到肚子一阵剧痛。

senses.en: courage and determination

example.en: She didn't have the guts to tell him the truth.
example.zh: 她没有胆量告诉他真相。

senses.en: to destroy the inside of a building, or to remove the insides of a fish before cooking
senses.zh: 掏空内部；取出（鱼等的）内脏

example.en: The fire gutted the old warehouse.
example.zh: 大火烧毁了那座旧仓库的内部。

senses.en: a piece of a plant used to grow a new plant

example.en: Take a cutting from the rose and put it in water.
example.zh: 剪下一段玫瑰插条，放进水里。

senses.en: a clipping from a newspaper or magazine

example.en: She kept a cutting of the article about her team.
example.zh: 她保存着那篇关于她所在球队报道的剪报。

senses.en: (of words or remarks) harsh and hurtful

example.en: She made some cutting remarks about his cooking.
example.zh: 她说了几句尖刻的话，讥讽他的厨艺。

senses.en: bitterly cold and penetrating

example.en: A cutting wind blew across the field.
example.zh: 刺骨的寒风吹过田野。

senses.en: a small piece of food, especially bread, that falls off

example.en: She brushed the crumbs off the table.
example.zh: 她把面包屑从桌上掸掉。

senses.en: a very small amount of something

example.en: There wasn't a crumb of truth in his story.
example.zh: 他的故事里没有一点儿真实。

senses.en: to cover food with breadcrumbs before cooking

example.en: Crumb the fish before frying it.
example.zh: 煎鱼之前先裹上面包屑。

senses.en: relating to forces, motion, or continuous change over time; the technical form of 'dynamic'
senses.zh: 动力的；动力学的；动态的

example.en: The engineers studied the dynamical behavior of the bridge under wind loads.
example.zh: 工程师们研究了桥梁在风荷载下的动态行为。

senses.en: of high quality or satisfactory

example.en: This is a good book.
example.zh: 这是一本好书。

senses.en: kind or morally right

example.en: She is good to her friends.
example.zh: 她对朋友很友善。

senses.en: benefit or advantage; moral rightness

example.en: Exercise does good to your health.
example.zh: 锻炼对健康有好处。

senses.en: an institution of higher education where students study for degrees

example.en: She went to college to study computer science.
example.zh: 她上大学学习计算机科学。

senses.en: a school or division within a university for a particular field of study

example.en: He is a professor in the College of Engineering.
example.zh: 他是工程学院的教授。

senses.en: relating to the present or recent times; up to date

example.en: She lives in a modern apartment with lots of natural light.
example.zh: 她住在一套采光很好的现代公寓里。

senses.en: using new ideas, styles or methods

example.en: The office has a modern design with open workspaces.
example.zh: 这间办公室采用开放式工作区的现代设计。

senses.en: a person with modern tastes or ideas

example.en: He considers himself a modern who questions old traditions.
example.zh: 他自认为是一个质疑旧传统的现代人。

senses.en: a small furry animal kept as a pet that catches mice

example.en: My cat sleeps on the sofa all day.
example.zh: 我的猫整天睡在沙发上。

senses.en: a wild animal of the cat family, such as a lion or tiger

example.en: The tiger is the largest cat in the world.
example.zh: 老虎是世界上最大的猫科动物。

senses.en: becoming greater in size, amount or degree

example.en: The increasing cost of housing worries many young people.
example.zh: 不断上涨的住房成本让许多年轻人担忧。

senses.en: (music) gradually getting louder or faster

example.en: The passage is played with increasing volume.
example.zh: 这一段以渐强的方式演奏。

senses.en: the reestablishment of friendly relations, especially between countries
senses.zh: （尤指国家间的）和解；恢复友好关系

example.en: The two nations moved toward a rapprochement after years of tension.
example.zh: 经过多年紧张关系后，两国开始走向和解。

senses.en: full of energy, courage, or liveliness

example.en: The team gave a spirited performance in the final minutes.
example.zh: 球队在最后几分钟的表现充满斗志。

senses.en: the nose and mouth of an animal such as a dog

example.en: The dog sniffed the ground with its muzzle.
example.zh: 狗用口鼻嗅着地面。

senses.en: the open end of a gun barrel

example.en: Smoke rose from the muzzle of the cannon.
example.zh: 烟从炮口升起。

senses.en: a covering placed over an animal's mouth to prevent biting

example.en: Some parks require dogs to wear a muzzle.
example.zh: 有些公园要求狗戴口套。

senses.en: to silence or prevent someone from expressing opinions

example.en: The law was seen as an attempt to muzzle the press.
example.zh: 这项法律被视为压制新闻界言论的企图。

senses.en: to officially tell someone off for doing wrong

example.en: The manager reprimanded him for missing the deadline.
example.zh: 经理因他错过截止日期而训斥了他。

senses.en: an official expression of strong disapproval

example.en: He received a written reprimand for the error.
example.zh: 他因这一错误受到了书面训诫。

senses.en: (informal, dated, chiefly North American) a female student at a college that admits both sexes

example.en: The dormitory was reserved for coeds in the 1960s.
example.zh: 二十世纪六十年代这栋宿舍专供女大学生使用。

senses.en: open to students of both sexes; involving men and women together
senses.zh: 男女同校的；男女混合的

example.en: She joined a coed volleyball team.
example.zh: 她加入了男女混合排球队。

senses.en: to think that something will happen

example.en: We expect rain later today.
example.zh: 我们预计今天晚些时候会下雨。

senses.en: to demand that someone do something because it is their duty

example.en: The teacher expects students to arrive on time.
example.zh: 老师期望学生准时到。

senses.en: to be waiting for someone or something to arrive

example.en: She is expecting a call from the doctor.
example.zh: 她在等医生的电话。

senses.en: used to ask for a choice from a known set of things
senses.zh: 哪一个；哪些（用于从已知范围中选择）

example.en: Which of these books is yours?
example.zh: 这些书中哪一本是你的？

senses.en: used before a noun to ask about a specific one or ones from a set
senses.zh: 哪一（个）；哪些（用于名词前提问）

example.en: Which train goes to the airport?
example.zh: 哪趟火车去机场？

senses.en: used to refer to a thing already mentioned and add more information about it
senses.zh: （关系代词）指代前文提到的事物或情况，并引出补充说明

example.en: The report, which was published today, explains the delay.
example.zh: 今天发布的报告解释了延误原因。

senses.en: a woman employed to clean and do housework in a home or hotel

example.en: The hotel maid cleaned the room every morning.
example.zh: 酒店清洁女工每天早上打扫房间。

senses.en: an unmarried girl or young woman (old use)

example.en: In old stories, a young maid often meets a prince.
example.zh: 在古老的故事里，年轻的少女常遇见王子。

senses.en: the brutal killing of many people at once

example.en: The massacre of civilians shocked the whole world.
example.zh: 对平民的大屠杀震惊了全世界。

senses.en: to kill a large number of people brutally and indiscriminately

example.en: Hundreds of villagers were massacred during the war.
example.zh: 战争期间数百名村民遭到残杀。

senses.en: (informal) to defeat someone very badly, especially in a game or contest
senses.zh: （非正式）（比赛等中）彻底击败；使惨败

example.en: Our team was massacred in the final.
example.zh: 我们队在决赛中被彻底击败。

senses.en: a wild animal with a pointed muzzle, bushy tail, and reddish fur, related to the dog

example.en: A fox slipped through the garden at night.
example.zh: 一只狐狸夜里溜进了花园。

senses.en: a clever or deceitful person

example.en: Don't trust him—he's a real fox in business deals.
example.zh: 别信他——他做生意是个老狐狸。

senses.en: to confuse or deceive someone

example.en: The tricky question foxed most of the students.
example.zh: 这道刁钻的题目难住了大多数学生。

senses.en: dirty, smelly, or very unpleasant
senses.zh: 恶臭的；污秽的；令人厌恶的

example.en: The room had a foul smell.
example.zh: 房间里有一股恶臭。

senses.en: an act in a sport that breaks the rules

example.en: The referee called a foul during the game.
example.zh: 裁判在比赛中判了一次犯规。

senses.en: to make something dirty, or to break the rules in a sport

example.en: He fouled the other player in the final minute.
example.zh: 他在最后一分钟对另一名球员犯规了。

senses.en: in a way that breaks the rules

example.en: The player was accused of playing foul.
example.zh: 这名球员被指比赛行为违规。

senses.en: honest and direct in speech, even when the truth is uncomfortable

example.en: She gave a frank answer about why the project failed.
example.zh: 她坦率地说明了项目失败的原因。

senses.en: to stamp a piece of mail to show that postage has been paid or to mark the date
senses.zh: 在邮件上盖（邮资已付/日期）戳

example.en: The machine franked all the letters automatically.
example.zh: 机器自动给所有信件盖了邮戳。

senses.en: a frankfurter; a smoked sausage served in a bread roll (informal, mainly North American)

example.en: We grilled franks at the picnic.
example.zh: 我们在野餐时烤了热狗肠。

senses.en: a sudden bright flame or light

example.en: A flare lit up the night sky.
example.zh: 一颗照明弹照亮了夜空。

senses.en: to burn briefly and brightly, or suddenly become angry

example.en: Tempers flared during the debate.
example.zh: 辩论中人们怒气爆发。

senses.en: a sudden worsening of a disease or condition

example.en: Her arthritis flare lasted several days.
example.zh: 她的关节炎发作持续了好几天。

senses.en: to make cloth, baskets, etc. by interlacing threads or strands

example.en: She learned to weave baskets from straw.
example.zh: 她学会了用稻草编篮子。

senses.en: to move in and out or follow a winding path

example.en: The cyclist weaved through the heavy traffic.
example.zh: 骑车人穿行在拥挤的车流中。

senses.en: the pattern or way in which a fabric is woven

example.en: This fabric has a tight weave.
example.zh: 这种织物织得很紧密。

senses.en: not well known or not clearly understood
senses.zh: 鲜为人知的；模糊难懂的

example.en: She quoted an obscure writer from the 1920s.
example.zh: 她引用了一位二十世纪二十年代鲜为人知的作家。

senses.en: difficult to understand because of unclear expression

example.en: The legal document was full of obscure wording.
example.zh: 这份法律文件充满了晦涩的措辞。

senses.en: to hide or make something less clear

example.en: Thick clouds obscured the moon.
example.zh: 厚厚的云层遮住了月亮。

senses.en: extremely tall; rising high above others

example.en: Towering cliffs rose above the valley.
example.zh: 高耸的悬崖矗立在山谷之上。

senses.en: (of emotions or qualities) very great or intense

example.en: She felt towering anger at the unfair decision.
example.zh: 对这一不公正的决定，她感到怒火中烧。

senses.en: calm and peaceful, not worried or upset

example.en: She looked calm and serene despite the noise around her.
example.zh: 尽管周围很吵，她看起来依然平静安详。

senses.en: (of a place or sky) quiet, clear and without trouble

example.en: We spent the evening by the serene lake.
example.zh: 我们在宁静的湖边度过了那个傍晚。

senses.en: the person or thing most likely to win; one that is best liked
senses.zh: 热门；最受喜爱的人或物

example.en: She is the favourite to win the race.
example.zh: 她是这场赛跑的夺冠热门。

senses.en: liked more than all others

example.en: Red is her favourite colour.
example.zh: 红色是她最喜欢的颜色。

senses.en: to mix things or people together

example.en: Guests from both families intermingled at the party.
example.zh: 两家的宾客在聚会上相互交融。

senses.en: a position of power or increasing influence (usually 'in the ascendant')

example.en: The party was in the ascendant after its election victory.
example.zh: 该党在大选获胜后势头正盛。

senses.en: rising or becoming more powerful

example.en: Streaming services are an ascendant force in entertainment.
example.zh: 流媒体服务是娱乐业中一股上升的力量。

senses.en: an ancestor

example.en: She traced her ascendants back several generations.
example.zh: 她把家谱追溯了几代人。

senses.en: to officially cancel a law, license, or right

example.en: The authorities can revoke a license for repeated violations.
example.zh: 当局可以因屡次违规吊销执照。

senses.en: to smell very unpleasantly

example.en: The room reeked of cigarettes.
example.zh: 房间里满是烟臭味。

senses.en: to strongly suggest something bad

example.en: The deal reeks of corruption.
example.zh: 这笔交易散发着腐败的气息。

senses.en: a strong unpleasant smell

example.en: A reek of rotten eggs filled the kitchen.
example.zh: 厨房里弥漫着一股臭鸡蛋味。

senses.en: an animal that feeds on dead or discarded things

example.en: Vultures are scavengers that feed on dead animals.
example.zh: 秃鹫是以动物尸体为食的食腐动物。

senses.en: a person who collects things that others have thrown away

example.en: Scavengers searched the bins for recyclable materials.
example.zh: 拾荒者在垃圾桶里搜寻可回收物。

senses.en: the parts of the body that contract to move the body

example.en: Exercise strengthens your muscles.
example.zh: 锻炼能增强你的肌肉。

senses.en: power or force, especially when used to pressure others

example.en: The company used its financial muscles to buy out competitors.
example.zh: 该公司利用其财力收购了竞争对手。

senses.en: to force your way somewhere, or use power roughly

example.en: He muscled his way to the front of the crowd.
example.zh: 他强行挤到了人群前面。

senses.en: unpleasant but possible to endure

example.en: The heat was unpleasant but just sufferable.
example.zh: 天气很热，但勉强可以忍受。
